title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.00626v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains large language models with teacher guidance on student-generated trajectories, addressing the mismatch between fixed demonstrations and the histories encountered during deployment. As its use expands across language model training, different formulations of supervision and optimization make it difficult to compare methods and understand when they are effective. This survey develops a unified view of OPD through the interplay between student-generated states, teacher information, and policy updates. This framework connects the foundations of distillation with self-distillation, multi-teacher integration, reinforcement learning, and interactive agents. We examine how these settings change the supervision available to the student and relate the resulting design choices to capability transfer, training efficiency, and deployment. Our synthesis centers on the conditions under which guidance remain

translated_title: 大语言模型在线策略蒸馏综述
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏在大语言模型的训练中，由教师模型对学生模型自身生成的轨迹提供指导，从而解决了固定示范与部署时实际遇到的交互历史之间的不匹配问题。随着其在语言模型训练中的应用不断扩展，不同的监督与优化形式使得各方法之间难以比较，也难以理解它们在何种情况下有效。本综述通过学生生成状态、教师信息与策略更新三者之间的相互作用，构建了对在线策略蒸馏的统一视角。该框架将蒸馏的基础方法与自蒸馏、多教师集成、强化学习以及交互式智能体联系起来。我们考察了这些设置如何改变学生模型可获得的监督信号，并将由此产生的设计选择与能力迁移、训练效率及部署应用相关联。我们的综述聚焦于教师指导在何种条件下能够持续（改进学生模型）……
tldr: 这篇综述论文通过学生生成状态、教师信息与策略更新三者之间的相互作用，建立了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的统一分析框架，并将其与自蒸馏、多教师集成、强化学习和交互式智能体等方向联系起来，系统阐释了不同方法的设计选择对能力迁移、训练效率和部署的影响。
en_tdlr: This survey establishes a unified framework for On-Policy Distillation (OPD) through the interplay between student-generated states, teacher information, and policy updates, connecting distillation foundations with self-distillation, multi-teacher integration, reinforcement learning, and interactive agents, and relating design choices to capability transfer, training efficiency, and deployment.
